risks.title: Oil and Gas Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: WTI oil prices for 2025 were down approximately 15% compared to prior year. Oil and gas price fluctuations directly impact royalty revenues and net income given the company's concentrated exposure in Permian Basin operations.

risks.title: Permian Basin Production Dependency
risks.score_rationale: TPL's revenue is substantially dependent on oil and gas production decisions by operators in the Permian Basin. Reduced production activity would negatively impact royalty revenues.

risks.title: Regulatory and Environmental Risk
risks.score_rationale: Operations are subject to environmental and energy regulations. Regulatory changes could increase compliance costs or impact operational ability to generate revenues.

risks.title: Credit Facility Risk
risks.score_rationale: Company established a $500 million revolving credit facility in October 2025 with maturity in 2029. No borrowings had been drawn as of December 31, 2025, but future borrowings could increase financial leverage.

risks.title: Market Competition
risks.score_rationale: TPL operates in a competitive energy market with other royalty and non-operating companies competing for assets, operations, and investment opportunities.

risks.title: Environmental and Climate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Oil and gas production activities carry inherent environmental risks including potential accidents, spills, and contamination that could damage reputation and reduce revenues.

ai_positioning.summary: Texas Pacific Land Corporation does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 2025 Form 10-K. No AI references are present in the disclosed sections.
